timeline.summary: Man Infraconstruction announced the acquisition of development rights and purchase for the Tardeo 2.0 project in South Mumbai with an estimated sales potential of ₹2,000+ crore.

Man Infraconstruction Limited’s Q4 FY26 earnings conference call for analysts and investors is scheduled for May 14, 2026, at 04:00 PM IST, hosted by **Manan Shah**, Managing Director, with the Senior Management Team.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹145.52 Cr (-50.5% YoY), net profit ₹41.04 Cr (-57.8% YoY) (includes ₹1.12 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹39.92 Cr).
Man Infraconstruction reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹145.5 Cr and PAT of ₹41.0 Cr.
Man Infraconstruction released its Monitoring Agency Report for the preferential issue of warrants for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Man Infraconstruction Limited rescheduled Q4 FY26 earnings conference call from 04:00 PM IST to 02:00 PM IST on May 14, 2026, as per **Durgesh Dingankar** and **Suhas Dingankar**.
MICL Group acquired an ultra-luxury residential development off Bandstand, Bandra West with ₹1,000+ Cr GDV, holding a ~70% stake.
In Q4 FY26 earnings call, Man Infraconstruction guided for ~₹5,600 Cr GDV launches in FY27 and a 2-year sales target exceeding ₹5,000 Cr.
Man Infraconstruction Limited will host an in-person Analysts/Investors Group Meeting on June 05, 2026, at Aaradhya Avaan Site, Tardeo, Mumbai.
MICL Group received the Occupancy Certificate for Towers C & D of Aaradhya Parkwood (₹925+ Cr GDV) 31 months ahead of schedule.
Man Infraconstruction released an investor presentation detailing its Vision 2031 roadmap targeting ₹35,000 Cr GDV and ₹6,700+ Cr of launches for FY27.
Man Infraconstruction Limited held Q1FY27 Virtual Analyst Meet on August 21, 2026, reporting 29% YoY PAT growth to ₹72 Cr and maintaining FY27 guidance.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹266.01 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹62.76 Cr (includes ₹3.14 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹62.09 Cr).
Q2 & H1 FY27 presentation: launch pipeline GDV increased to ₹9,500+ Cr following Marine Lines collaboration with Godrej; ₹127.38 Cr of buyback completed.
Man Infraconstruction filed the monitoring agency report for Q2FY27 showing ₹49.20 Cr unutilized preferential issue proceeds.
